The '''Athallia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the planet [[Athallia]], homeworld of [[Fin Mak'lath]].

The ''[[Athallian Messenger]]'' was probably named after this system.
